stage: M1 source coverage and Teacher/F paired acquisition

standing.rule: first high-level boundary with both foot support>=20N and planar root speed<.08

goal_arm5.rule: first boundary with both foot support>=20N, planar root speed<.12 and actual wrist-shoulder X shift>=.015m vs3s

motion_walk_task.rule: first boundary with root vx>.05 and either left or right foot load<20N; otherwise first positive vx>.05 boundary; explicitly record fallback

source_selection_scope: No contact; real native prefix. Selection uses body/support only, not contact outcome. If no state matches, retain boundary and do not invent posture.

independence.policy: same native prefix/source trajectory and its branches remain one group even if seed/time/request differs. Pilot groups train only. No claim of12 independent groups. If fewer than64 genuinely independent prefixes available, report actual and data limitation; do not manufacture by seed changes.

search.original7: exact interactive_pilot.propose/command;7 candidates24 decisions2.4s; unchanged physics reward
search.phase: Student visited state phase=0, previous_plan=None cold restart; only actual Teacher execution advances its own phase; never borrow native/other trajectory phase
search.partner_prediction: current position/velocity/yaw, constant velocity; no actual future/stop time
search.F: same checkpoint forward_map at actual first interpolated z and actual first low-level action; full F tensor and fixed forward015 preprojection embedding score; not full sequence return

actual_branches.native: same source continues using own real source phase/time; descriptive control, no old actor
actual_branches.best_sequence: one original7 query at onset+.1, execute selected24-command plan in actual environment, then BC500 to actual release+4s
actual_branches.rolling: only4 preselected cells, replan20 times; then BC500, full aftermath; never call whole episode a Teacher rollout

gate.window: entire actual post-handoff episode contact window plus full release; no gate from2.4s prediction alone
gate.combine: usable if either actual selected sequence branch or actual rolling branch meets ALL bounds and relative BC leg; record which. Candidate chosen only by unchanged physical reward, not gate peeking.
gate.no_contact: external force exactly0; no termination; full planned completion; original boundary minheight>=.45 and maxtilt<=30deg, not added posture constraint
gate.loaded_slip_definition: max actual ground foot contact tangential speed at contacts with measured normal force>1e-6N; all-contact legacy proxy retained separately

decision: pilot gate fails -> generation capability insufficient with any independent-data limitation separate; gate passes but cannot supply qualified independent groups -> data qualification insufficient; continue M2 only if qualified coverage/assets, never launch it
extra_FB: 0 planned pilot, full F on ALL original7 including failures. Extra80 cap retained, no candidates added to official pool
heldout: No sealed evaluation or adjustment during pilot. If gatepasses, seal remaining independent-prefix split before expansion. No mixed sameprefix splits.
ledger: count predictions, actual Teacher first commands, BC, native, restores, resets and failures separately; sum concurrent job seconds
thresholds: user-specified stage gate, not universal research requirements
scope: Supplemental exact historical joint-domain positive controls; do NOT change12-cell pilot denominator/threshold, not replacement attempts.3 queries added within original96. Same native prefix groups. Record24cm with no user absolute16-29cm bin: diagnostic only, do not invent qualification gate.
